sourceEnglishTitle: Unexpected Rotten Deck: Change Order with the Homeowner
sourceEnglishObjective: Tell a homeowner what you found under the old roof, propose the repair, and get a signed change order
sourceEnglishSpeaking: You are the crew lead and the AI is the homeowner: describe what you found during the tear-off and what it looked like, propose the repair with its cost and extra time using the conditional, and ask for a signature on the change order.
sourceSpanishReaderTitle: What We Found Under the Shingles

sourceGrammar.focus: Preterite vs imperfect; conditional for the proposal

examples.es: Cuando quitamos las tejas, encontramos madera podrida.
examples.en: When we removed the shingles, we found rotten wood.

examples.es: La cubierta estaba blanda; cambiarla costaría más.
examples.en: The deck was soft; replacing it would cost more.

example.target: Rogelio encuentra madera podrida cerca de la chimenea.
example.native: Rogelio finds rotten wood near the chimney.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Preterite: encontré, encontramos. The o to ue change happens only in the present.

example.target: Cuando quitamos las tejas, encontramos madera podrida.
example.native: When we removed the shingles, we found rotten wood.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Preterite for a finished action: quitamos, quité.

example.target: La cubierta estaba blanda en esta sección.
example.native: The deck was soft in this section.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Imperfect for what things were like: estaba, había, parecía.

example.target: Costaría más y tomaría un día extra.
example.native: It would cost more and take an extra day.

sourceVerbExamples.note: Conditional for a proposal: costaría, tomaría.

example.target: Le recomendaría cambiar tres hojas de triplay.
example.native: I would recommend replacing three sheets of plywood.

sourceVerbExamples.note: The conditional softens advice: le recomendaría.

candidateObjective: 家主に撤去後に見つかった腐朽箇所を説明し、補修案と署名付き変更注文書を扱う。
candidateFocus: ～たとき places the discovery after tear-off. ～ことをお勧めします makes a polite proposal; ～ため states why signed authorization precedes repair.

archivedForms.exampleJa: ロヘリオは煙突の近くで腐朽した木材を見つけます。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: Rogelio finds rotten wood near the chimney.

archivedForms.exampleJa: シングル材を撤去したとき、腐朽した木材が見つかりました。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: When we removed the shingles, we found rotten wood.

archivedForms.exampleJa: この区画の野地板は柔らかくなっていました。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: The deck was soft in this section.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 費用が増え、もう一日かかります。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: It would cost more and take an extra day.

archivedForms.exampleJa: 合板三枚の交換をお勧めします。
archivedForms.exampleEnglish: I would recommend replacing three sheets of plywood.

archivedSpeaking.opening: シングル材を撤去したとき、腐朽した木材が見つかりました。写真をお見せし、合板三枚の交換と追加費用を変更注文書でご説明します。
archivedSpeaking.goal: Tell the homeowner about rotten deck found during tear-off. Show the photos, explain the proposed repair, added cost and time, and request authorization on the change order politely.

cards.archivedJapanese: 柔らかい、または腐朽した野地板
cards.reviewNote: Soft or rotten deck is an observation and repair scope, not a confirmed structural diagnosis.
Change order is a contract document; confirm Japanese legal/business sense in context.
Authorization and signature workflow depends on contract and locale.
Rafter staining is observed, not proof the rafter needs replacement.

cards.sourceSpanish: Cuando quitamos las tejas, encontramos madera podrida.
cards.sourceEnglish: When we removed the shingles, we found rotten wood.
cards.candidateJapanese: シングル材を撤去したとき、腐朽した木材が見つかりました。
cards.archivedJapanese: シングル材を撤去したとき、腐朽した木材が見つかりました。
cards.archivedEnglish: When we removed the shingles, we found rotten wood.

cards.sourceSpanish: La cubierta estaba blanda en esta sección.
cards.sourceEnglish: The deck was soft in this section.
cards.candidateJapanese: この区画の野地板は柔らかくなっていました。
cards.archivedJapanese: この区画の野地板は柔らかくなっていました。
cards.archivedEnglish: The deck was soft in this section.

cards.sourceEnglish: I would recommend replacing three sheets.
cards.archivedJapanese: 合板三枚の交換をお勧めします。
cards.archivedEnglish: I would recommend replacing three sheets.
cards.reviewNote: Three-sheet proposal depends on qualified assessment and owner approval.

cards.sourceSpanish: Costaría más y tomaría un día extra.
cards.sourceEnglish: It would cost more and take an extra day.
cards.archivedJapanese: 費用が増え、もう一日かかります。
cards.archivedEnglish: It would cost more and take an extra day.
cards.reviewNote: Extra cost/time are estimates, not universal outcomes.

cards.sourceEnglish: Shall I show you the photos?
cards.candidateJapanese: 写真をお見せしましょうか。
cards.archivedJapanese: 写真をお見せしましょうか。
cards.archivedEnglish: Shall I show you the photos?

cards.sourceSpanish: Necesito su firma en la orden de cambio.
cards.sourceEnglish: I need your signature on the change order.
cards.archivedJapanese: 変更注文書にご署名をお願いします。
cards.archivedEnglish: I need your signature on the change order.
cards.reviewNote: Signature requirement depends on contract and local process.

cards.candidateJapanese: ねえ、これを見に来てください。
cards.archivedJapanese: ねえ、これを見に来てください。

reader.sourceSpanish: A las nueve de la mañana, la cuadrilla terminó el desmontaje del lado norte.
reader.sourceEnglish: At nine in the morning, the crew finished the tear-off on the north side.
reader.candidateJapanese: 午前九時、作業班は北側の既存屋根材の撤去を終えました。
reader.archivedJapanese: 午前九時、作業班は北側の既存屋根材の撤去を終えました。
reader.archivedEnglish: At nine in the morning, the crew finished the tear-off on the north side.

reader.sourceSpanish: Kevin pisaba con cuidado cuando sintió que la cubierta se hundía.
reader.sourceEnglish: Kevin was stepping carefully when he felt the deck sinking.
reader.archivedJapanese: ケビンは慎重に歩いているとき、野地板が沈むのを感じました。
reader.archivedEnglish: Kevin was stepping carefully when he felt the deck sinking.
reader.reviewNote: Deck felt soft underfoot; safe access around damaged structure needs qualified review.

reader.sourceSpanish: Kevin: Oye, ven a ver esto.
reader.sourceEnglish: Kevin: Hey, come look at this.
reader.candidateJapanese: ケビン「ねえ、これを見に来てください。」
reader.archivedJapanese: ケビン「ねえ、これを見に来てください。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Kevin: Hey, come look at this.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio revisó el área con la barreta: la madera estaba negra y húmeda, y una viga tenía manchas.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio checked the area with the pry bar: the wood was black and damp, and a rafter had stains.
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオはバールでその場所を確認しました。木材は黒く湿っており、垂木にも染みがありました。
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio checked the area with the pry bar: the wood was black and damp, and a rafter had stains.
reader.reviewNote: Pry-bar inspection and rafter staining are observations, not structural clearance.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio tomó fotos del daño y marcó la orilla con pintura.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio took photos of the damage and marked the edge with paint.
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオは損傷箇所を撮影し、塗料で縁に印を付けました。
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio took photos of the damage and marked the edge with paint.
reader.reviewNote: Marking damaged edge and photo process require site safety review.

reader.sourceSpanish: Después bajó a hablar con el dueño de la casa, el señor Ramírez.
reader.sourceEnglish: Then he went down to talk with the homeowner, Mr. Ramírez.
reader.candidateJapanese: その後、家主のラミレスさんと話すために下へ降りました。
reader.archivedJapanese: その後、家主のラミレスさんと話すために下へ降りました。
reader.archivedEnglish: Then he went down to talk with the homeowner, Mr. Ramírez.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: Señor Ramírez, cuando quitamos las tejas, encontramos madera podrida.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: Mr. Ramírez, when we removed the shingles, we found rotten wood.
reader.candidateJapanese: ロヘリオ「ラミレスさん、シングル材を撤去したとき、腐朽した木材が見つかりました。」
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「ラミレスさん、シングル材を撤去したとき、腐朽した木材が見つかりました。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: Mr. Ramírez, when we removed the shingles, we found rotten wood.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: La cubierta estaba blanda en esta sección, cerca de la chimenea, y parecía que el agua entraba desde hacía años.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: The deck was soft in this section, near the chimney, and it looked like water had been getting in for years.
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「煙突の近くのこの区画では野地板が柔らかく、何年も水が入っていたように見えました。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: The deck was soft in this section, near the chimney, and it looked like water had been getting in for years.
reader.reviewNote: Years of water entry is a visual inference, not confirmed duration.

reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: Shall I show you the photos?
reader.candidateJapanese: ロヘリオ「写真をお見せしましょうか。」
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「写真をお見せしましょうか。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: Shall I show you the photos?

reader.sourceSpanish: Sr. Ramírez: Sí, por favor. ¿Y eso no estaba en el presupuesto?
reader.sourceEnglish: Mr. Ramírez: Yes, please. And that wasn't in the estimate?
reader.candidateJapanese: ラミレスさん「はい、お願いします。それは見積書に入っていなかったのですか。」
reader.archivedJapanese: ラミレスさん「はい、お願いします。それは見積書に入っていなかったのですか。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Mr. Ramírez: Yes, please. And that wasn't in the estimate?

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: No, porque nadie podía verlo antes del desmontaje; para eso sirve la orden de cambio.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: No, because nobody could see it before the tear-off; that's what the change order is for.
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「はい。撤去する前は誰にも見えなかったため、変更注文書で扱います。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: No, because nobody could see it before the tear-off; that's what the change order is for.
reader.reviewNote: Change-order contractual explanation is locale/contract dependent.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: Le recomendaría cambiar tres hojas de triplay y revisar la viga.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: I would recommend replacing three sheets of plywood and checking the rafter.
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「合板三枚を交換し、垂木を確認することをお勧めします。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: I would recommend replacing three sheets of plywood and checking the rafter.
reader.reviewNote: Three-sheet replacement and rafter check are proposed, not approved scope.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: Costaría más y tomaría un día extra, y el costo adicional aparece aquí, por escrito, como dice el contrato.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: It would cost more and take an extra day, and the extra cost appears here, in writing, as the contract says.
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「費用が増え、もう一日かかります。契約書にあるとおり、追加費用はここに書面で示しています。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: It would cost more and take an extra day, and the extra cost appears here, in writing, as the contract says.
reader.reviewNote: Cost and timeline depend on a written estimate and contract.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: No podemos tapar madera podrida, porque los clavos nuevos no agarrarían bien.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: We can't cover rotten wood, because the new nails wouldn't hold well.
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「腐朽した木材を覆うことはできません。新しい釘が十分に効かないからです。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: We can't cover rotten wood, because the new nails wouldn't hold well.
reader.reviewNote: Do not cover rotten wood is a source command requiring qualified structural/roofing review.

reader.sourceSpanish: Sr. Ramírez: Está bien, entonces hágalo.
reader.sourceEnglish: Mr. Ramírez: All right, then do it.
reader.candidateJapanese: ラミレスさん「分かりました。では、お願いします。」
reader.archivedJapanese: ラミレスさん「分かりました。では、お願いします。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Mr. Ramírez: All right, then do it.

reader.sourceSpanish: Rogelio: Gracias; necesito su firma en la orden de cambio, porque sin su autorización no podemos empezar la reparación.
reader.sourceEnglish: Rogelio: Thank you; I need your signature on the change order, because without your authorization we can't start the repair.
reader.archivedJapanese: ロヘリオ「ありがとうございます。補修を始めるには承認が必要ですので、変更注文書にご署名をお願いします。」
reader.archivedEnglish: Rogelio: Thank you; I need your signature on the change order, because without your authorization we can't start the repair.
reader.reviewNote: Signature and authorization procedure depends on contract and locale.

type.label: Type 'I need your signature on the change order' in Japanese.

say.label: Explain the rotten deck, proposed repair, extra cost, and signed change order to the homeowner.

write.label: Write what the crew found and why it was not in the original estimate.

curriculumAdaptationNote: The source shows suspected rotten deck under shingles, photographs, a proposed three-sheet repair, extra time/cost and a change-order signature before starting. Preserve observed damage versus inferred water history, proposal versus authorization, and contract-specific workflow. Safe access around a soft deck and rafter assessment require qualified review. Grammar and five Spanish verbs are pinned separately. No selected learner/audio text or progress identity is created.
